data.description: Experience Beachfront Living Between Abu Dhabi and Dubai

data.answer: Living in Ghantoot is perfect for those who crave a beachfront lifestyle away from the city's fast pace. The community promises a luxurious standard of living, offering high-end amenities and a host of public facilities that cater to daily needs and comfort. Notable upcoming projects include Bayn by Ora Developers and Ohana By The Sea by Ohana Development, both set to redefine coastal living with premium design and thoughtfully planned infrastructure.

Properties in Ghantoot primarily feature villas with distinctive architectural layouts. Home options range from spacious 2 to 7-bedroom residences, covering areas from 1,410 sq. ft. up to an expansive 12,917 sq. ft. These villas often blend traditional Arabic design elements—such as courtyards and majlis—with modern interiors that include rustic stone finishes. Surrounded by beautifully landscaped gardens, the homes provide a serene setting, while residential plots in the area also offer investors the opportunity to create luxurious second homes. 

Popular Buildings in Ghantoot

The Ghantoot residential area is currently in its developmental phase and does not feature high-rise buildings or apartment complexes. The focus remains on low-density, villa-style communities that blend seamlessly with the natural coastal environment. As the area continues to develop, future projects may introduce a variety of residential structures, but for now, the emphasis is on spacious villas and townhouses.

Off-Plan Projects in Ghantoot

The area highlights a surge in off-plan developments, reflecting the region's growing appeal among investors and homebuyers. Noteworthy projects include Bayn by Ora Developers, Ohana by The Sea by Ohana Development, Budoor Villas, and Kayan. These developments offer a range of options from beachfront villas to wellness-focused residences, catering to diverse lifestyle preferences. 

Renting a Property in Ghantoot

For those considering living in Ghantoot, the rental market offers a selection of properties that combine luxury with comfort. Rental options include spacious villas, with prices varying based on size and location. For instance, a 2-bedroom villa may rent for approximately AED 120,000 annually. 

Buying a Property in Ghantoot

Investing in Ghantoot Abu Dhabi real estate presents a promising opportunity for buyers seeking upscale properties in a strategic location. The market features a variety of options, including villas and land plots. Prices for villas can range from AED 2.85 million for a 2-bedroom unit to over AED 8.5 million for larger, beachfront properties.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Ghantoot, Abu Dhabi?

data.answer:
Life in Ghantoot, Abu Dhabi offers a peaceful coastal retreat with luxurious living, blending nature, privacy, and modern amenities away from the city's hustle.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Ghantoot

Parking is hassle-free in Ghantoot Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, as most villas come with spacious covered parking areas that can accommodate multiple vehicles based on the property’s size. For guests and visitors, outdoor parking is generally available along the villa-lined streets, adding to the convenience of residential living.

While the community continues to develop, public transportation options in Ghantoot remain limited. The nearest bus and metro stations are situated in nearby communities and can take approximately 25 minutes to reach by car, making personal vehicles the primary mode of transport for now.

Supermarkets in and Around Ghantoot

Currently, living in Ghantoot means relying on limited retail options, with Ghantoot Palace Grocery Store serving as the primary supermarket for residents’ daily needs. For a broader selection, nearby stores such as Sunrise Supermarket, Wheatfields Supermarket, and Season DIC Supermarket are accessible within a 20-minute drive. 

As development projects progress, the area is expected to host multiple grocery outlets and retail hubs, enhancing everyday convenience for future residents.

Shopping Malls Near Ghantoot

For shopping and leisure, residents of Ghantoot Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates can visit The Outlet Village by Meeras, a premier destination offering high-end fashion brands at affordable prices. This mall, designed with charming Tuscan-inspired streets, also features a variety of cafes and restaurants serving international cuisine, including popular names like P.F. Chang’s, Aghaty, Godiva, Starbucks, and Project Pie. 

Located just a 19-minute drive from Ghantoot, it’s complemented by other nearby shopping centers such as Ibn Battuta Mall and the Mall of the Emirates, providing ample retail and entertainment options.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Ghantoot

Families living in Ghantoot currently have limited access to schools within the immediate community, requiring a short commute to neighboring areas for education. Nearby districts such as Jebel Ali and Dubai Investments Park host reputable institutions like The Winchester School, Ghaf Primary School, and Delhi Private School—all located approximately 25 to 30 minutes away by car.

For higher education, residents benefit from proximity to some of Dubai’s top universities. Within a manageable drive, options include the University of Wollongong in Dubai, the University of South Wales, and the American University in Dubai, making Ghantoot a practical base for families prioritizing quality education.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Ghantoot

Spiritual life in Ghantoot Abu Dhabi is anchored by the Mosque of the Mother of Ali Mohammed Sadiq Al Balushi, located on the eastern edge of the community near Sheikh Maktoum Bin Rashid Road. Nearby places of worship include Al Ghadeer Mosque, Jebel Ali Mosque, and Al Samha Central Mosque, offering residents convenient options for daily prayers.

For non-Muslim residents, churches are primarily found in the Jebel Ali area, with popular options like St. Francis of Assisi Church, Dubai Mar Thoma Church, and the United Christian Church of Dubai within reach. Additionally, Sikh and Hindu community members can visit the Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurdwara and several Hindu temples, all located within a 30-minute drive from the community.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Ghantoot

Access to healthcare is convenient for residents of Ghantoot Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, with several well-regarded medical facilities located in nearby areas. Hospitals such as Mediclinic Meadows, NMC Royal Hospital, and Al Zahra Hospital in Dubai are within a 30-minute drive and offer comprehensive healthcare services. Mediclinic, in particular, is known for its expertise in family medicine, dermatology, and obstetrics, ensuring that residents have access to quality care close to home.

Location & Nearby Areas

Thanks to its strategic location, Ghantoot residential area offers seamless connectivity to both Abu Dhabi and Dubai. To the east lies Al Ghadeer, while Al Samha is situated to the south of the community. Heading north, residents can quickly reach Jebel Ali and Dubai Investments Park, making Ghantoot an ideal choice for those who need convenient access to key residential and commercial zones in both emirates.

Al Maktoum International Airport is just a 30-minute drive away. For entertainment and leisure, Dubai Parks and Resorts is conveniently located only 17 minutes from the community. Residents can reach Mina Jebel Ali in about 26 minutes, while nature lovers will appreciate the nearby Jebel Ali Wildlife Sanctuary, which is just a 24-minute drive from Ghantoot.

Ghantoot offers a variety of leisure and recreational activities that perfectly complement its tranquil coastal lifestyle.

Restaurants

Ghantoot offers a variety of casual dining and café options right within the community, making it easy for residents to enjoy meals close to home. Popular spots include Najmat Al Seeh Restaurant, Ghantoot Royal Restaurant, and Royal View Restaurant. For familiar fast-food favorites, outlets like McDonald’s, Tim Hortons, and Subway are also conveniently located throughout the area. 

For those craving fine dining experiences, some of Dubai’s best restaurants—such as Ossiano at Atlantis The Palm, At. Mosphere, Zuma, and Carnival by Tresind—are about an hour’s drive away.

Beaches Near Ghantoot

Thanks to its proximity to Sahel Al Emarat, residents of Ghantoot can easily enjoy nearby beaches just a short drive away. One popular spot is Golden Tulip Bungalows, a family-friendly public beach offering all the essential amenities for a relaxing day by the sea.

Hotels in and Around Ghantoot

Golden Tulip Al Jazira Hotel and Resort, a 4-star gem in Ghantoot Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, offers guests 80 well-appointed rooms featuring satellite TV, mini-bars, digital safes, and tea and coffee-making facilities. 

The hotel’s casual dining option, Brasserie on Zero, serves international cuisine throughout the day. It also houses Euro Star Cellars, one of Abu Dhabi’s premier liquor stores, known for its extensive selection of beers, spirits, ciders, and fine wines. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a swimming pool, lounge bar, pool bar, and a dedicated kids’ pool, making it a great spot for families and travelers alike.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

The Ghantoot residential area is beautifully enhanced with lush green spaces, where thousands of trees have been planted to create a refreshing oasis amid Abu Dhabi’s desert landscape. Once current developments are complete, residents can look forward to dedicated cycling tracks and jogging trails to support an active outdoor lifestyle.

For fitness enthusiasts, nearby gyms such as Vogue Fitness, The Big Gym, and Mia Fitness Centre provide excellent facilities for regular workouts. Meanwhile, those seeking relaxation can visit Happy Valley Spa & Massage Centre in Ghantoot, where skilled therapists offer a range of treatments including Moroccan baths, Thai massage, signature massages, and full-body therapies.

Community Events

Ghantoot Racing & Polo Club is a vibrant hub for polo and sports enthusiasts, hosting several prestigious events throughout the year. For those interested in traditional and cultural festivals, Dubai Parks and Resorts—just a short drive from Ghantoot—offers a variety of celebrations and entertainment experiences that bring the community together.

Attractions and Landmarks

Ghantoot Racing & Polo Club stands as one of the most prestigious leisure destinations in the community. Founded in 1994 under the guidance of His Highness Sheikh Zayed Bin Sultan Al Nahyan and currently managed under the patronage of his son, His Highness Sheikh Falah Bin Zayed Al Nahyan, it is the only polo club in the emirate. 

Spanning an impressive 300 hectares of lush grassland, the club boasts world-class polo and equestrian facilities, including eight polo fields, stables housing over 300 polo ponies, a 2,000-seater grandstand, a swimming pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, and fine dining options.

Another landmark gem in Ghantoot is the Ghantoot Marina and Resort, featuring 250 berths, a beach club, and a spa for ultimate relaxation. The marina offers a variety of water sports such as water skiing, scuba diving, and parasailing, making it a favorite weekend getaway. Notably, Xtreme Wake located here is one of Dubai’s top wakeboarding spots. Fishing enthusiasts will also find the marina’s waters ideal for a tranquil day out.

For those seeking adrenaline-pumping fun, Ghantoot hosts the largest paintball field in the UAE — Battle Park. Spanning nearly half a million square feet, it offers seven indoor and outdoor themed battlegrounds where players engage in exciting matches using low-impact 0.48 calibre guns. Recognized as one of the best paintball venues in the country, Battle Park is a must-visit for thrill-seekers in the region.

Ghantoot’s strategic location makes it an ideal choice for those seeking beachfront living with easy access to the heart of the city. However, as the community is currently undergoing significant development, residents may need to wait a little longer before moving into their dream homes.

Where is Ghantoot located?

Ghantoot is a coastal area situated between Abu Dhabi and Dubai, offering easy access to both emirates.

What types of properties are available in Ghantoot?

Ghantoot primarily features villas ranging from 2 to 7 bedrooms, built in traditional Arabic designs with modern interiors.

Are there any community events or social clubs in Ghantoot?

While still developing, Ghantoot hosts polo tournaments and sports events at the Ghantoot Racing & Polo Club, with plans for more community gatherings as the area grows.

data.content:
Ghantoot Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, is a serene coastal area perfectly positioned between the bustling cities of Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Renowned for its tranquil ambiance and natural beauty, this unique locale offers a peaceful retreat while maintaining proximity to two major urban centers. 

With scenic views of the Arabian Gulf, Ghantoot stands out as a destination of both leisure and exclusivity. It is home to prominent attractions such as the Ghantoot Marina and the prestigious Ghantoot Racing & Polo Club. These landmarks enhance the lifestyle appeal of the region, offering both residents and visitors access to elite sporting and maritime experiences.

 The Ghantoot residential area is set to feature a selection of upscale villas ranging from 2 to 7-bedrooms, designed with contemporary aesthetics in mind. Located along the western edge of the community, Sheikh Maktoum Bin Rashid Road (E11) provides convenient connectivity to nearby districts, making daily commuting or weekend getaways to Abu Dhabi or Dubai both easy and efficient.

nodes.title: Y Views at Bayn
nodes.about:
Y-Views at BAYN by ORA is a luxurious residential villa development located in the serene coastal area of Ghantoot, Abu Dhabi. As part of the prestigious BAYN master-planned community, Y-Views is designed for those seeking spacious, high-quality homes in a private, low-density environment.

The project consists of 5 to 7-bedroom villas tailored for modern family living, providing ample space, functional layouts, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor areas. Residents will enjoy expansive private gardens, terraces, and a tranquil atmosphere, ideal for families or those seeking a peaceful retreat.
